player_prompt.intro:
I kɛra Mastermind.
I faa tɔgɛ koodi ti a yɛ {code_length} wɔɔrɛ la, kɔɔrɔ kɔɔrɔ ka tãã {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
I tɔgɛ la, i pɛnɛ ka tɔgɛ koodi kɛɛlɛ kɛɛlɛ: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Kɔɔrɔ kɔɔrɔ i tɔgɛ, i faa tɔgɛ feedback kɛɛlɛ kɔɔrɔ ɲɛɛrɛ ɲɛɛrɛ.
Ɲɛɛrɛ ɲɛɛrɛ i tɔgɛ koodi kɛɛlɛ kɔɔrɔ, ɲɛɛrɛ ɲɛɛrɛ i tɔgɛ koodi kɔɔrɔ kɔɔrɔ.
I faa {max_turns} wɔɔrɛ tɔgɛ koodi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: I pɛnɛ ka tɔgɛ koodi kɛɛlɛ kɛɛlɛ wɔɔrɛ la.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Yaa ka pɛɛra kɔɔbɩ {code_length} kɔɔbɩ wɛɛlɛ.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kɔɔbɩ wɛɛlɛ ka taa 1 nɛ {num_numbers} kɔɔbɩ.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: Wɔɔgɔ ziɛɛ wɛɛndɛɛ kɔɔri kɔɔri ka fa ka ziɛɛ.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Y zoe n mii {guess}. Bɩ y mak bũmb a to sẽn yaa toor-toore.

game_action.feedback: Yaa ka pɛɛra [{guess}]. Saa: {black_pegs} kɔɔbɩ bɛɛlɛ, {white_pegs} kɔɔbɩ wɛɛlɛ.

outcome.win: Yaa ka zɛɛlɛ koodi, yaa ka cɛn {black_pegs} kɔɔbɩ {code_length} kɔɔbɩ wɛɛlɛ
outcome.turn_limit: Wɛɛlɛ ka taa. Yaa ka cɛn {percent} pɔɔsɛɛntɩ kɔɔbɩ wɛɛlɛ.
